//: The repository root has a package.json, for the site's own build scripts.
Deno sees it while resolving this service, switches into Node compatibility
mode, and then refuses to start because there is no node_modules folder:
error: Could not find "js-yaml" in a node_modules folder.
The service does not want that mode. It has one dependency, js-yaml, and
Deno can fetch it straight from npm into its own cache -- no node_modules,
no install step, nothing for the site's tooling to collide with. That is
Running the app from this folder rather than the repository root keeps the
two worlds apart: the site's package.json belongs to the site's build, and
this file belongs to the service.
